_doc: The Human Baseline - Master Scene Registry. Each scene anchors an act or pivotal narrative setting.

scenes.name: Pete's Auto Diagnostics - Bay 2
scenes.ambientDescription: The smell of 5W-30 motor oil, warm exhaust, and crisp brake cleaner fills the afternoon air as hydraulic lifts hum with rhythmic work.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Life before the squeeze. The bays are busy, customers pay cash and card without flinching, and the timing belts run smooth.
scenes.defaultObjective: Finish timing adjustment on the sedan and wrap up Friday shop work.

scenes.name: Oakridge Liquors - Annex 4
scenes.ambientDescription: Polished commercial linoleum reflects warm amber glass displays as hand trucks clatter over the delivery threshold.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Adriana manages a full Friday team, signing delivery manifests and coaching clerks without automated micro-scheduling.
scenes.defaultObjective: Clear the intake manifests and help prep the weekend promotional endcaps.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Backyard Patio
scenes.ambientDescription: The charcoal grill sizzles under a calm amber twilight, surrounded by lawn chairs, cold bottles, and easy laughter.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Marcus, Todd, and Adriana share dinner, recounting their week and talking about future career plans before the shift begins.
scenes.defaultObjective: Enjoy the weekend cookout with Marcus and Adriana.

scenes.name: Oakridge Liquors - Employee Breakroom
scenes.ambientDescription: A humming refrigerator and a newly installed wall tablet flashing scheduling alerts cast a sterile LED glare across the corkboard.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Corporate Workforce Management software rolls out, automatically shaving minutes from clerk shifts and tightening floor coverage.
scenes.defaultObjective: Navigate the new automated scheduling mandates with the floor crew.

scenes.name: Pete's Auto Care - Quick Bay
scenes.chapterTitle: Act II: Tuesday Morning Lube Service
scenes.ambientDescription: The morning sun cuts through high bay windows. Marcus's compact sedan is up on the center lift for a scheduled oil service.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Marcus stops in for service, enthusiastically discussing automated code assistants while unaware of corporate hiring freezes.
scenes.defaultObjective: Complete lube service on Marcus's vehicle and hear about his firm's new tech rollout.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Kitchen Table
scenes.ambientDescription: Grocery receipts and utility statements rest beside two warm mugs of tea under the gentle amber glow of the pendant lamp.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Todd and Adriana cross-reference their days, recognizing that while their jobs are safe, the broader economic ground is shifting.
scenes.defaultObjective: Review the month's expenses and discuss the workplace shifts over evening tea.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Patio - Sunday Afternoon
scenes.ambientDescription: Dry leaves skitter across the deck. Marcus sits at the patio table staring blankly into a lukewarm can of soda, looking exhausted.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Marcus is laid off after senior developers absorb junior workloads using automated code tools; hundreds of job applications lead to automated rejections.
scenes.defaultObjective: Talk with Marcus about the layoff and his prospects.

scenes.name: Oakridge Liquors - Department Office
scenes.ambientDescription: Adriana's cramped desk is covered in printed resumes—not from teenagers, but from experienced desk workers with four-year degrees.
scenes.milestoneSummary: A single 16-hour part-time stocker posting attracts 42 applicants, including former copywriters, paralegals, and financial analysts.
scenes.defaultObjective: Review the overwhelming application stack for the part-time shelf stocker position.

scenes.name: Pete's Auto Care - Diagnostic Station
scenes.ambientDescription: Marcus's car idles roughly in Bay 3 with an amber check engine light. A manufacturer dealer tablet demands a $400 cloud license to read the ECM fault code.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Todd bypasses a proprietary dealer software paywall using an open-source OBD-II pin bridge to fix Marcus's car off-the-books.
scenes.defaultObjective: Diagnose Marcus's rough idle and bypass the dealer software paywall.

scenes.name: Pete's Auto Care - Wednesday Morning
scenes.ambientDescription: Only one hydraulic lift is elevated. Two bays stand idle and clean as vehicle miles traveled drop across the county.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Vehicle miles traveled drop 25% as former commuters work gig shifts or stay home; preventative maintenance intervals stretch out.
scenes.defaultObjective: Discuss shop volume with Pete and inspect a customer's grinding brakes.

scenes.name: Pete's Auto Care - Lift 1
scenes.ambientDescription: A worn silver crossover sits on Lift 1 with metal-on-metal brake rotors. Elena, a gig worker, waits anxiously by the service desk.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Todd negotiates parts and waives diagnostic fees so a struggling gig-delivery mother can keep driving safely.
scenes.defaultObjective: Perform brake job triage for Elena's delivery vehicle.

scenes.name: Oakridge Liquors - Front Register & Self-Checkout
scenes.ambientDescription: Unstaffed self-checkout kiosks flash red override lights while plexiglass security cabinets lock away standard spirits.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Automated self-checkout triggers record product shrinkage, leading corporate to lock basic goods behind glass cases while blaming floor staff.
scenes.defaultObjective: Manage frustrated shoppers and unlock high-theft inventory cases.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Living Room - Evening
scenes.ambientDescription: County tax reassessment notices and utility surcharges cover the coffee table. Rain taps against the window glass.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Downtown commercial real estate vacancies trigger an 18% residential property tax hike to offset lost municipal revenue.
scenes.defaultObjective: Review the county property tax reassessment and utility surcharges.

scenes.name: Suburban Physical Therapy Clinic
scenes.ambientDescription: The smell of menthol rub and heating pads fills the waiting room. Marcus wears an elastic lumbar support belt over his work shirt.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Marcus faces the biological reality of manual trades at 31 after suffering an L5 disc herniation pulling commercial wire as an apprentice.
scenes.defaultObjective: Check in on Marcus after his physical therapy appointment.

scenes.name: Pete's Auto Care - Main Office
scenes.chapterTitle: Act V: The Corporate Buyout Offer
scenes.ambientDescription: A glossy corporate franchise buyout prospectus sits on Pete's desk, promising subscription cloud tools in exchange for store surrender.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Pete and Todd reject a national corporate chain takeover, choosing to keep the garage independent and double down on legacy vehicles.
scenes.defaultObjective: Decide the future of Pete's Auto Care with Pete.

scenes.name: Shady Pines Assisted Living - Intake Office
scenes.chapterTitle: Act VI: The Great Caregiving Crucible (Years 10–12)
scenes.ambientDescription: A glossy brochure detailing a $9,200 monthly memory-care rate sits on an imitation cherrywood desk. Call lights chime relentlessly from the hall.
scenes.actTitle: Act VI: The Great Caregiving Crucible
scenes.milestoneSummary: Private-equity-owned care facilities price gouge at $9,000/month with severe staff shortages as the Boomer generation reaches their late 80s.
scenes.defaultObjective: Review elder-care costs and staffing realities with the admissions director.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Home - Converted Bedroom
scenes.chapterTitle: Act VI: The Home Caregiving Crucible
scenes.ambientDescription: The smell of rubbing alcohol and clean laundry. Todd tightens heavy lag bolts securing a stainless steel transfer grab bar into wall studs.
scenes.actTitle: Act VI: The Great Caregiving Crucible
scenes.milestoneSummary: Todd and Adriana retrofit their guest room to care for an aging parent at home, balancing exhausting shifts with physical transfers and medications.
scenes.defaultObjective: Complete safety retrofit of the ground-floor bedroom.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Kitchen - 2:00 AM
scenes.ambientDescription: The hum of the refrigerator in the pitch dark. A single kitchen nightlight illuminates a pill organizer and a glass of water.
scenes.actTitle: Act VI: The Great Caregiving Crucible
scenes.milestoneSummary: Through bone-deep exhaustion, Todd and Adriana's resilience and shared sacrifice turn a grueling generational crisis into unbreakable solidarity.
scenes.defaultObjective: Manage 2 AM medication schedule and check on each other.

scenes.name: Regional Logistics Hub - Picket Line
scenes.chapterTitle: Act VII: The Breaking Point & The Pushback (Years 13–15)
scenes.ambientDescription: Steam plumes rise from burn barrels in the chilly pre-dawn air. Hundreds of warehouse workers and delivery drivers hold strike signs under floodlights.
scenes.actTitle: Act VII: The Breaking Point & The Pushback
scenes.milestoneSummary: Warehouse workers strike against biometric pacing software and inhuman pick quotas, triggering a nationwide labor mobilization.
scenes.defaultObjective: Stand in solidarity with warehouse and retail workers at the distribution gate.

scenes.name: State Senate Committee Room 304
scenes.chapterTitle: Act VII: The Right to Repair Testimony
scenes.ambientDescription: Carved mahogany panels and microphone stands. Todd stands before the Commerce Committee in his cleanest technician shirt with Pete beside him.
scenes.actTitle: Act VII: The Breaking Point & The Pushback
scenes.milestoneSummary: Todd delivers fiery, grounded testimony holding a seized OBD-II telemetry lock, forcing lawmakers to confront automaker software monopolies.
scenes.defaultObjective: Testify on the record against manufacturer software locks.

scenes.name: Local Machinists & Clerks Union Hall
scenes.ambientDescription: Fold-out metal chairs packed wall-to-wall under buzzing fluorescent tubes. A live news broadcast on the projection screen announces legislative debate.
scenes.actTitle: Act VII: The Breaking Point & The Pushback
scenes.milestoneSummary: Widespread public exhaustion with corporate speedups forces federal politicians to introduce the Emergency Fair Hours Act.
scenes.defaultObjective: Celebrate the legislative breakthrough with community organizers.

scenes.name: Oakridge Liquors - Restructured Department Board
scenes.ambientDescription: A clean, newly printed 4-day shift rotation is posted on the breakroom board. The mood is calm, confident, and rested.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The federal 32-hour workweek takes effect; Adriana expands her permanent team and promotes long-time part-timers into stable full-rate jobs.
scenes.defaultObjective: Roll out the permanent 32-hour rotation schedule to the department staff.

scenes.name: Pete & Todd's Auto Care - Apprentice Bay
scenes.chapterTitle: Act VIII: The New Apprentice Line
scenes.ambientDescription: Pete's name is joined by Todd's on the newly painted shop sign. Two twenty-year-old vocational apprentices watch Todd demonstrate an analog diagnostic probe.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Todd trains the next generation in diagnostic intuition, rebuilding the manual mentorship chain broken during the early automation rush.
scenes.defaultObjective: Teach apprentice Maya how to verify crankshaft sensor waveform.

scenes.name: Todd & Adriana's Backyard - Friday Afternoon
scenes.ambientDescription: Golden sunlight washes over the quiet patio. It's Friday at 3:00 PM—the new universal weekend. Friends, apprentices, and family gather in peace.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Two decades after the squeeze began, society has settled into a dignified human baseline. Work is honest, time is reclaimed, and the future is steady.
scenes.defaultObjective: Celebrate the 20-year journey with Adriana, Marcus, and the community.
